c.title: $6,398 / 3br - 2953ft2 - Dunbar 3Br+1Den/2.5Ba Whole House for Rent, Lord Byng Catchment (Vancouver)
c.description:
Available: December 1, 2026 or January 1, 2027 – December 31, 2027. Earlier move in possible.

Beautifully Renovated Dunbar Home with Rooftop Views

This exceptional Dunbar residence on West 22nd Avenue has been extensively renovated from top to bottom, offering 2,953 sq. ft. of upscale modern living space plus over 650 sq. ft. of patios and decks in one of Vancouver's most sought-after neighbourhoods.

The home features 3 bedrooms, a den, and 2.5 bathrooms, with spacious, light-filled living areas throughout. High-end finishes include engineered hardwood flooring, a large gourmet kitchen with heated slate floors and stainless steel appliances, and spa-inspired bathrooms designed for comfort and luxury.

The main floor opens onto a private sun deck and fully fenced backyard, ideal for family gatherings, BBQs, and entertaining. A spectacular rooftop patio offers panoramic views of the city skyline and the North Shore Mountains.

Conveniently located just minutes from shopping, restaurants, and everyday amenities. Situated within the Lord Byng Secondary, Lord Kitchener Elementary, and St. George’s School catchment areas.

Viewing Requests

Please contact us for additional information or to arrange a viewing. Selected applicants will be invited for a private showing.

When requesting a viewing, please include:

Your occupation
Number of occupants
Desired move-in date

References are required. Credit checks and proof of income will be requested prior to tenancy approval.
